text:
priya: heads-up — deploying kernel v2.14.0 + quant build qf-2026-03 tonight 23:00 UTC. plan: staggered canary (1%, 5%, 25%), automatic pin if error rate >0.5% for >5min. need manual OK for cross-region swap. cc @deploybot for preflight.

deploybot: deploybot scheduled job deploy-5180001234; preflight scheduled 22:30 UTC. will run prebake + smoke. will post status updates here.

sam: risk check — the matmul ABI bump: any known fallback gaps for older runtime shards? especially regional-legacy pool.

jonathan: ABI bump is opt-in for legacy pool, we left shim on but it only covers ~2% traffic. fallback exists: you can pin back to v2.13 immediately. rollback CLI (tested):
```
/deploy rollback deploy-5180001234 --reason "rollforward fail"
```
Also recommend pinning model-kernel v2.13 for critical customers during promotion.

lina: release notes draft incoming: "improved matmul perf, reduced peak mem by ~12%, quant compatibility fixes, regressed rare kv-cache miss fixed" — I'll push a short RN after canary succeeds.

alex: telemetry gates we agreed: p99 latency delta < 8% AND error-rate delta < 0.2% AND GPU temp < 85C. who can trigger a manual sticky pin if needed?

priya: I have permission to pin region+pool. jonathan can you enable deploybot sticky pin TTL = 2h so ops can investigate without flip-flopping?

jonathan: done — deploybot supports sticky pins. command used: `deploybot pin set --id deploy-5180001234 --ttl 2h --scope region-eu` — will apply if auto-pin fires or manual pin invoked.

eva: quick heads-up — the quant build includes a small batcher change that can alter KV cache write-back timing. please run local kv-check bench: `./tools/bench_q.sh --kv-check` (took ~3m on my dev VM).

deploybot: preflight passed (22:31 UTC): prebake ok, smoke ok, checksum matches. canary scheduled: will start 1% at 23:00 UTC. /status to query progress.

sam: 👍 also, can someone add a postmortem stub early? template: /docs/postmortems/runtime-deploy.md so we don't scramble if we hit regressions.

priya: will create stub now and assign ops-oncall. ops, please watch redis evictions and OOM alerts for first 15m after each promotion step. I'll be monitoring in #oncall and IRC.

deploybot: canary 1% started 23:00:15 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5180001234 — tagging for visibility :green_heart:

jonathan: if canary stable at 23:10 UTC we promote to 5%. watch p99, kv-miss-rate, and cpu temp spikes. promote command: `deploybot promote --id deploy-5180001234 --to 5%`

eva: FYI I saw a small p50 bump on my dev run but p99 stayed fine — probably batch alignment. keep an eye on tokenization tail.

priya: acknowledged. will wait for SRE thumbs-up before >5% and call rollback immediately if error-rate hits threshold. tag #eng-sre for any anomalies.

deploybot: 23:07 UTC — canary health ok. no error spikes, p99 +4%. proceeding to 5% at 23:12 UTC unless blocked.

sam: thanks team. ping me if we need to escalate; I can coordinate customer pins for sensitive tenants.

priya: thanks — will update RN after full promotion. closing loop here unless anyone sees something to flag."
